threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think it's normal to stand on the right on the escalators. Watch out for the looks from the locals!
Saw a guy on the 133 last night trying to barter with a busker. They settled on a handful of change for a rendition of 'Wonderwall'. Classic Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Standing in line at the Döner place on Weserstraße, I realized everyone was debating the best last stop for a night out—only in Neukölln does that feel like community.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Kreuzberg, you'll find spontaneous street concerts breaking out, often led by a random accordion player. It's like a free music festival every weekend.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by how they react when BART breaks down—they roll their eyes and pull out a book, not the panic I see from tourists.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a dog lounging on the tracks at Civic Center, a Muni classic. The way commuters just shrugged and waited? So SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they’ll find a quiet haven in Gràcia, but on match days, it’s a rowdy festival of Barça fans. Totally different vibe.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by the way they struggle with the 'Gràcia' pronunciation; they say 'Graa-sia' instead of 'Grat-zi-a'.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still wait for a bus at the stop instead of just walking to your destination. Everyone else knows the best shortcuts through the estates.
Last night on the 196, a group of lads serenaded a pigeon outside Brixton Station. The bird looked more entertained than me.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I spotted a wild cat sunbathing on my balcony while the BVG went on strike. Who knew urban life had such wild surprises?

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find people debating whether a bus will actually arrive during a strike, while sipping craft beer at the stop. It's a whole vibe!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here when they know which BART station to avoid during a rainstorm. Civic Center's a no-go when the roof leaks.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a dog casually sunbathing on the Muni tracks today. Crew was trying to coax it off while commuters just smiled. Classic SF vibe.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just stroll down Verdi for tapas, but locals know to hit up the hidden bars on Carrer del Sol for the real vibe.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their bewilderment at the winding streets—most locals navigate them like a second language, while newcomers clutch their maps.
